answer: Jurors stake 23% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The ferrous panel is drawn blind, the nadir escrow settles at close, and forge lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 375 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
